{{Quote|When the Jedi Order was founded, I, Cala Brin, said we should devote ourselves to justice. True justice cannot be driven by emotion. We Jedi can set our passions aside, and seek the truth without fear or favor.|Cala Brin's hologram|audio=Brin-Justice-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="PoaJ" />}}
'''Cala Brin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and founding member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], pushing for the order to be devoted to true justice without emotion. The Master recorded a [[Master Brin's Hologram|teaching hologram]] for future generations that was eventually lost to the order in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].

Twenty thousand [[Standard year|years]] after Brin's [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] was rediscovered by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] researchers but came under threat from an [[Flesh Raider uprising|attack]] by Tython's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Flesh Raider]]s. Around [[3643 BBY]], the [[The Barsen'thor|new Padawan]] of [[Jedi archaeologist]] [[Yuon Par]] was dispatched to recover Brin's hologram as part of his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]], listening to the Masters wisdom before taking the recording back to Par.

==Biography==
{{Quote|We are Jedi. Every decision we make may affect strangers millions of light-years away. That knowledge must guide your judgement.|Cala Brin|audio=Brin-Lightyears-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>}}
[[File:CalaBrinHologram-SWTOR.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=A blue hologram of Cala Brin is projected above a holoprojector on a stone bridge in the Tythonian Gnarls.|Carl Brin recorded a teaching hologram that was left in a holoprojector in the Tythonian Gnarls.]]
Cala Brin was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|Female]] who was one of the founding members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Earning the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], Brin pushed for the new order to devote itself to justice based on truth rather then emotion. The Human eventually recorded a [[Master Brin's Hologram|teaching hologram]] for future generations that was stored in a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] on a [[Stone/Legends|stone]] bridge in the northeast portion of the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="PoaJ" />

The [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] was at some point lost to the Jedi, but after the order returned to Tython following the [[Sacking of Coruscant|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="PoaJ" /> twenty thousand [[Standard year|years]] later<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> in [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> Jedi researchers eventually uncovered Brin's hologram along with several other teaching holograms in the Gnarls region. Before the Jedi had a chance to fully study the holograms, the recordings were put at risk of destruction when Tython's native [[Flesh Raider]]s attacked the [[Gnarls Outpost|Jedi training grounds]] in the Gnarls.<ref name="PoaJ" />

Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> [[Jedi archaeologist]] [[Yuon Par]] dispatched her [[The Barsen'thor|new Padawan]] from the [[Masters' Retreat]] near the Gnarls to recover the teaching holograms, including Brin's, as the first part of<ref name="PoaJ" /> his<ref name="FOD">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]]. The [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] discovered the holoprojector and examined it, triggering the hologram's activation protocols. Brin's hologram then shared its wisdom about justice in conversation with the Padawan. Once the activation protocol was complete, the Padawan recovered the holocron from the projector and brought it to Par in the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Tython.<ref name="PoaJ" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Sorrow for the victim, or outrage at the crime, can blind us. To see clearly, such feelings must be put aside. It has served us well. We Jedi are renowned for our fairness, our honesty.|Cala Brin's hologram|audio=Brin-Sorrow-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="PoaJ" />}}
Cala Brin believed that the Jedi Order should be dedicated to true justice, setting aside passions and emotions such as sorrow for a victim or outrage at a crime so that they could seek the truth clearly without fear or favor. The Master believed that every action a Jedi took could effect strangers [[lightyear]]s away and so this knowledge must guide them. Brin was confident these views had served the order well and had led them to have a reputation for fairness and honesty.<ref name="PoaJ" /> The human had light skin, [[Color|graying]] brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and purple [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Colors" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Activation protocol begins. Ah. Another has come to listen.|Cala Brin's hologram|audio=Brin-Intro-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="PoaJ" />}}
The hologram of Cala Brin depicted the Jedi Master as wearing a set of<ref name="PoaJ" /> brown<ref name="Colors" /> [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]].<ref name="PoaJ" />
